custom_dimensions.rationale: Which entry point (home hero, check page, sticky bar) started, completed and qualified free checks. Decides where the free check is placed. Closed three-value enum.
Whether a started check was entered as a PIN or an address. Decides which input the form leads with. Closed two-value enum; never the typed value.
Which canonical outcome a completed check produced. Shows how much of the completed-to-qualified drop is the evidence rather than friction. Closed enum from the outcome matrix.
Which tier (T2 or T3) a checkout attempt was for. Purchase already carries the tier as the built-in item variant.
Why a checkout attempt did not reach Stripe. Decides which gate or failure to work on first. Closed eleven-value enum; never the server message.

key_events.rationale: Server-side purchase from the signed webhook after settlement and the durable PAID transition. The only key event. Behavioral evidence only: paid revenue is the Stripe/order record.
